title: Fluent Bit Metrics

fields.name: scrape_interval
fields.description: The rate at which metrics are collected from the host operating system

fields.name: scrape_on_start
fields.description: Scrape metrics upon start, useful to avoid waiting for 'scrape_interval' for the first round of metrics.

fields.name: threaded
fields.description: Indicates whether to run this input in its own [thread](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#inputs).

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Tag assigned to records emitted by this input plugin.

description: Fluent Bit exposes its own metrics to allow you to monitor the internals of your pipeline.
